ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the two seats A and B in the “rotating swing” have equal masses and are suspended from the rotating disk by cables of the same length. Neglecting the effect of air resistance, when the rotating disk rotates uniformly about the vertical central axis, which of the following statements is correct (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: The tension in the cable suspending A is smaller than that in the cable suspending B

ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, the two seats A and B in the “rotating swing” have equal masses and are suspended from the rotating disk by cables of the same length. Neglecting the effect of air resistance, when the rotating disk rotates uniformly about the vertical central axis, what is the relationship between the tension in the cable suspending A and that suspending B?
ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: The tension in the cable suspending A is smaller than that in the cable suspending B
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the rotating disk rotates about the central axis shown by the vertical dashed line in the middle, and seat A and seat B are suspended at different positions on the right side of the disk; the position of A is closer to the central axis than B, and B is located farther outside, so it can be judged that the radius of circular motion of A is smaller than that of B, that is, r_A < r_B. Reasoning: The stem states that the two seats have equal masses, the cables have the same length, and they rotate uniformly with the same rotating disk about the vertical central axis, so A and B have the same angular velocity. Analyze the forces on any one seat: it is subjected to gravity mg and cable tension T; the vertical component of the tension balances gravity, and the horizontal component provides the centripetal force mω²r. Since A and B have equal masses and the same angular velocity, while the rotation radius of B is larger, the centripetal force required by B is larger. The gravity balanced in the vertical direction is the same, and the horizontal component for B is larger, so the total cable tension of B is larger. Therefore T_A < T_B.
